BiblicalUsage: Tilon is a son of Shimon, named in the genealogy of Judah. In 1 Chronicles 4:20, Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Tilon belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
